pedagogical_boundary: Early-tree prologue atmosphere only; Neo-Plastic MVP corpus remains orthogonal black-armature works.

formulae.title: Recursive binary branch (geometry_only)
formulae.basic_explanation: A deterministic recursive branching walk with fixed angle and length ratio. Used as atmosphere after early Mondrian trees; not a transcription of a fractal-dimension equation and not a Neo-Plastic grid.

citation.chicago: Bountis, Tassos, Athanassios S. Fokas, and Emmanouil Psarakis. 2017. “Fractal Analysis of Tree Paintings by Piet Mondrian (1872–1944).” International Journal of Arts and Technology 10 (1). https://doi.org/10.1504/ijart.2017.083902.
